426:t_100:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're persistent, $n. I'm $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_100:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Or don't you want to admit that your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ was this kind of brazen woman?」

426:t_100:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're adorable! If you weren't my student, I could have been more honest about it!」

426:t_100:5.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... I don't understand what state you're in right now...」

426:t_100:6.en:
$n
「But I'll get you back, no matter what! You're my partner, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_100:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're clinging to that tiny hope so despair won't defeat you! That's the spirit, $n!」

426:t_100:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Now, let's fight each other for the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$!」

426:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hold on, Miss $$スズネ$$! I'll save you right now!」

426:t_101:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「As expected, $$アルト$$. You've got a natural talent for handling women.」

426:t_101:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Hahaha, did I make you angry?! Your precious wings are wavering with rage!」

426:t_101:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If that upsets you, hurry up and settle your own affairs before you try to do anything about me!」

426:t_101:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...! Are these really Miss $$スズネ$$'s words?!」

426:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll stop Miss $$スズネ$$ with $$マジンガー$$'s power!」

426:t_102:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's no use, $$甲児$$. I know all your habits.」

426:t_102:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I know how you rely on $$マジンガー$$ when you fight too. You can't stop me like that.」

426:t_102:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That surprising sensitivity is your weakness.」

426:t_102:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you want to stop me, come at me ready to turn your beloved $$マジンガー$$ into a devil!」

426:t_102:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it... Damn it! What did $$バルビエル$$ do to Miss $$スズネ$$?!」

426:t_103:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You'll have to bear with this for a little while, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_103:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's rich coming from one of the class's two worst troublemakers. Why would I listen to you?」

426:t_103:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can't believe it... Is this really Miss $$スズネ$$?」

426:t_103:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「All women are like this. We carry another self inside us.」

426:t_103:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Your beloved $$千鳥かなめ$$ is the same. You'd better understand that.」

426:t_103:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't let you insult $$千鳥$$ any further...! Even if you're Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_104:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't let you hurt $n, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_104:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're as fierce as ever, $$カレン$$. But no one will want to marry you if you keep that up.」

426:t_104:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Mind your own business! I don't intend to wait for someone to take me as a bride! I'll seize what I want myself!」

426:t_104:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「We think alike. I'm the same way.」

426:t_104:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So get out of my way! If you interfere with me taking the $$スフィア$$, I'll crush you!」

426:t_105:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Please stop, Miss $$スズネ$$! I don't want to fight you!」

426:t_105:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm sorry, $$ワッ太$$. Your teacher has her reasons too...」

426:t_105:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you thought I'd say that, you're dead wrong. You might not want to fight, but I certainly do.」

426:t_105:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I show no mercy to anyone in my way, even children! That's how I've lived my life!」

426:t_105:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Damn it! You're a huge idiot, Miss $$スズネ$$! I can... fight when I have to, you know!!」

426:t_106:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do it, $$鉄人$$! Stop Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_106:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Go play with your toys at home, $$正太郎$$. You're an eyesore.」

426:t_106:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I can't believe it...! Miss $$スズネ$$ would never talk about $$鉄人$$ that way...」

426:t_106:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Accept it already. I'm $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_106:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm $$サイデリアル$$'s $$アムブリエル$$, not the sweet Miss $$スズネ$$ you all love!」

426:t_107:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「B-but... It's Miss $$スズネ$$...! She's our teacher!」

426:t_107:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're as soft as ever, $$シンジ$$. I can hardly believe you piloted the EVA that tried to destroy the world.」

426:t_107:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you don't intend to fight, that's convenient. That machine's $$Ａ．Ｔ．フィールド$$ is troublesome.」

426:t_107:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If all you'll do is cry and beg, get out of my way. I don't have time to babysit brats!」

426:t_108:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$...! How did this happen!?」

426:t_108:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Everyone carries another self inside. You should understand that, $$アマタ$$, right?」

426:t_108:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you talking about $$カグラ$$!?」

426:t_108:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's right. But that doesn't mean there's any way to stop me.」

426:t_108:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Especially not for you, fighting with your belief in something like love!」

426:t_108:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ gave her blessing to me and $$ミコノ$$...!」

426:t_108:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「What the hell are you?! Get out of Miss $$スズネ$$!!」

426:t_109:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've wanted to see you, $$竜馬$$!」

426:t_109:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've always wanted to fight you once! That dream is finally coming true!」

426:t_109:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Stop joking. Miss $$スズネ$$ is a good colleague of mine. She's nothing like a violent woman like you!」

426:t_109:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I told you already. I'm $$アムブリエル$$, not $$スズネ$$.」

426:t_109:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then I'll drive you out! To get our Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

426:t_110:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That was splendid, $$揺れる天秤$$. I never expected the aftereffects to save $n, though.」

426:t_110:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even a woman-hater like me could have some dreams about Miss $$スズネ$$, and your existence ruined them!」

426:t_110:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Sorry about that! But this is who I am!」

426:t_110:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll shut you up by force! For my sanity... and for $n!」

426:t_111:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「The $$傷だらけの獅子$$ and $$悲しみの乙女$$... I can just picture $$ストラウス$$ and $$バルビエル$$'s frustrated faces if I beat you.」

426:t_111:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「No way... I can't believe Miss $$スズネ$$ has changed this much...」

426:t_111:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Come to your senses, Miss $$スズネ$$! None of us want to fight you!」

426:t_111:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then stay out of my way. My top-priority target is $n.」

426:t_111:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's no use, $$セツコ$$! She isn't the type who'll listen to reason!」
